create.name: Bonnie Grace Gilday-Kennedy
create.bio:
Bonnie Grace Gilday-Kennedy is an Akashic Records consultant based in Black Mountain, just outside Asheville in North Carolina, where she runs a small practice called Grace of Healing. She has worked as a channel for what she calls the Akashic Masters for more than ten years, a path that opened for her after a period of personal tragedy and that she describes in her memoir, Embodying the Grace of Healing.

Her consultations run to about two hours. Clients arrive with questions, she relays what comes through from the Records about this life and earlier ones, with the focus on life purpose, repeating patterns and the beliefs that keep people stuck, and the session closes with a channelled chakra balancing. She sees people in person in Black Mountain and near Charlotte, works by phone and video with clients further afield, and runs occasional workshops that teach students to open their own Records or read for others. She also gives question-and-answer Akashic talks, posts short channelled messages on her YouTube channel, and teaches an introductory live online class for Omega Institute.

courses.title: An Introduction to the Akashic Records
courses.description: A 90-minute live online class for Omega's Teachers Studio series, open to complete beginners. She explains what the Records are understood to be, who the Akashic Masters are in this tradition, and leads a short guided practice followed by questions; registrants can replay it for six months.
courses.price: Member $35 USD, sliding scale $33 to $55 USD

courses.title: Akashic Consultation
courses.description: A one-to-one reading of roughly ninety minutes in which she answers your questions from the Records, touching on this life, earlier lives and your sense of purpose, followed by a half-hour channelled chakra balancing. Available in person in Black Mountain and near Charlotte, or by phone and video.
